receipt.description: C4: hash of the ledger entry that sealed this effect. Present only on an envelope delivered into a motor.* skill.

attest.description: C5: what the emitting skill asserts about how it produced this payload. An assertion bound to the effects it causes, not proof of what executed — see spec/c5-attestation.md.

usage.description: C5 v1.2: what the engine counted for this inference. Reported by the engine, never estimated by the skill.

trace.description: C3 v1.7: a W3C Trace Context traceparent. Supplied by a client on the envelope that starts a chain; carried by the kernel on every hop of that chain.

deadline.description: C3 v1.6: the unix-millisecond instant after which nothing this delivery causes is worth delivering. Set by the kernel on what it delivers, or by a client on the envelope that starts a chain; an Expertise reads it and never sets it. Late data is dropped. See spec/c2-graph-ir.md rule 7.

respond_by.description: C3 v1.8: the unix-millisecond instant by which the first output of this chain is due. A target, not a validity bound: a miss is recorded and nothing is dropped. Set like `deadline`. See spec/c2-graph-ir.md rule 9.

priority.description: C3 v1.6: the scheduling priority of the edge this delivery travelled. Higher wins; absent means 0, ordinary.

speculative.description: C3 v1.6: this delivery was made on partial upstream output and may be cancelled if the producer's final output differs (C2 rule 6).
